5_star.author: A
5_star.title: Great quality and absorption

4_star.author: A
4_star.title: Price increases every month
4_star.body: Protein is good. Taste is good. But this company pricing is strange. They keep increasing 200 rupees every month. With this rate, it will no longer be affordable in few months. So if you are trying to rely on one protein brand, you should rethink.

3_star.author: Philip
3_star.title: Too sweet and contains Sucralose.
